registry_estimate: Registry estimate (© 2026 Company Registry, all rights reserved; per-keyword figures may be quoted with attribution); method given on each value
wordstream_2026: LocaliQ/WordStream Search Advertising Benchmarks 2026 (US median CPC by industry)
wordstream_2025: WordStream Google Ads Benchmarks 2025 (16,446 US campaigns, Apr 2024-Mar 2025; median CPC and CTR by industry)
